title: D1 / Supabase Migration Plan
description: A structured plan for applying a schema migration to Cloudflare D1 or Supabase, so the repair-vs-execute trap and this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/migration_plan_audit.mjs.

platform.description: Which migration system this plan targets.

environment.description: The environment whose database the migration must actually change.

connection.description: Supabase only: how the SQL reaches the database. The pgbouncer pooler (port 6543) cannot run migrations.

d1Target.description: D1 only: whether wrangler applies with --remote (the real database) or --local (.wrangler/state). Wrangler defaults to local.

repairPlanned.description: Supabase only: true if `supabase migration repair --status applied` will be run for this migration.

sqlExecutedBeforeRepair.description: Supabase only: true if the migration SQL has actually been executed (psql / SQL editor) before any repair marks it applied.

verificationQueryPlanned.description: True if a post-apply query asserts the new shape against information_schema.columns / pragma_table_info, rather than trusting migration history.

addsNotNullColumn.description: True if the migration adds a NOT NULL column.

tableHasRows.description: True if the target table already contains rows in the target environment.

hasDefaultOrBackfill.description: True if the NOT NULL addition carries a DEFAULT, or follows the three-step nullable -> backfill -> NOT NULL pattern.

migrationFileEditedAfterApply.description: True if an already-applied migration file has been (or will be) edited instead of adding a new file.

hotTableLongMigration.description: True if the migration rewrites or indexes a large, hot production table.

batchedApproach.description: True if the hot-table work is batched (CONCURRENTLY index, chunked UPDATEs, shadow table + rename) instead of one long transaction.

forwardOnly.description: True if the migration is declared forward-only (no down-script expected).

downScriptTested.description: True if a down-script exists and has actually been executed against a copy of the schema.
